keySentence: Jack chopped it down to save his mother.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The beanstalk fell down. The giant was gone. Jack saved his mother. Jack chopped it down to save his mother.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The beanstalk crashed and the ground shook like an earthquake. The giant could never come down again. Jack and Mother hugged each other and cried with joy. Jack chopped it down to save his mother from danger. With the gold coins, they were never poor again. Jack became a true hero who protected his family.
